python - <<'PY'
import io, re
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream

def show(src):
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(src)))
    print(f"{src!r:34} -> {[(r.key, r.value) for r in rows]}")

# trailing whitespace variants
for s in ["A=v\n", "A=v \n", "A=v   \n", "A=v\t\n", "A=v \t \n"]:
    show(s)
print()
# inline comments
for s in ["B=v#c\n", "B=v #c\n", "B=v   #c\n", "B=v\t#c\n", "B='v' #c\n", 'B="v" #c\n']:
    show(s)
PY

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream

cases = {
    "trailing spaces": "X=value   \n",
    "trailing tabs": "X=value\t\t\n",
    "inline comment": "Y=word # comment\n",
    "no comment": "Z=word\n",
    "comment no space": "W=word#comment\n",
    "hash inside": "H=abc #x\n",
}
for name, text in cases.items():
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    for r in rows:
        print(f"{name:18} input={text!r:24} -> value={r.value!r}")
EOF
